title: rachel-hernandez-kubecon-2026-travel-admin-scratchpad
content:
Purpose: personal scratchpad for KubeCon 2026 travel logistics + expense reminders. Working notes, receipts tracking, vendor contacts, and TODOs. Not a finalized itinerary - see calendar invite + Confluence for final booking details.

Attendees / company contacts:
- Rachel Hernandez (owner) - rachel@redwood.com
- Alex Martinez - alex@redwood.com (flight share, ground transport)
- Sam Lee - sam@redwood.com (booth lead)
- Maya Singh - maya@redwood.com (speaker)

High-level trip details:
- Event: KubeCon North America 2026
- Dates on-site: 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-09
- Travel dates: 2026-04-05 (arrive evening) to 2026-04-10 (depart late)
- Location: Moscone Convention Center, San Francisco, CA

Flights (booked via Concur):
- Outbound (SFO): UA 1234, 2026-04-05 17:30, E-ticket 016-1234567890 (Rachel)
- Return: UA 4321, 2026-04-10 20:45, E-ticket 016-0987654321
- Note: checked bag on outbound; add baggage fee to expense. Keep boarding passes and bag receipts.

Hotel / lodging:
- Hotel: Grand Pacific Hotel (example) - confirmation #GP-98765 (booked under Redwood corporate rate)
- Address: 123 Market St, San Francisco, CA
- Check-in: 2026-04-05 15:00; check-out: 2026-04-10 12:00
- Invoice: request itemized invoice before check-out. For reimbursement, need hotel folio showing nightly rate + taxes.
- Wifi: avoid room charges; use conference wifi or company VPN. If charged, submit as expense with receipt and explanation.

Ground transport / local logistics:
- Airport -> Hotel: Lyft (pool considered) - estimated $35. Save receipt.
- Hotel -> Venue: 12 min by taxi / 20 min walk. Booth setup on 2026-04-06 morning.
- Airport -> Office (optional returns): keep Uber/Lyft receipts with map screenshot if needed for mileage verification.

Booth / shipping / vendors:
- Booth shipper: FastShip Logistics - contact: Jorge Ramos, jorge@fastship.com, +1-415-555-0199. Tracking #FS-2244. Confirm delivery date to Moscone 2026-04-04.
- Swag vendor: PrintHouse SF - contact: lisa@printhouse.com, PO# 2026-RW-058. Shipping ETA 2026-04-03. Save invoices for reimbursement and attach PO.
- AV support: Event AV team - av@kubecon.com; booth AV order confirmed (screen + power) - order #AV-7788.

Expense categories & reminders (per Redwood policy):
- Meals: per diem policy SFO $75/day - collect receipts for anything above per-diem and add a short justification.
- Transportation: flights, taxis, parking, tolls (keep receipts).
- Lodging: hotel folio required. No personal charges.
- Booth expenses: vendor invoices (PrintHouse, FastShip) - code to use: PROD_EVENTS_2026 (confirm with finance).
- Misc (client dinners, hospitality): pre-approval needed for >$500. Attach guest list and purpose.

Expense codes / GL mapping (confirm with finance):
- Travel - Flights: TRAVEL_FLIGHTS
- Accommodation: TRAVEL_HOTEL
- Events / Booths: MARKETING_EVENTS
- Swag: MARKETING_SWAG
- Shipping / Logistics: OPERATIONS_LOGISTICS
(Need to confirm final codes with finance@redwood.com before submitting final expense)

Receipts checklist (keep physical + digital):
- Flight e-tickets and receipts
- Hotel folio/invoice (itemized)
- Taxi/Uber/Lyft receipts (take screenshot + email receipt)
- Swag vendor invoices + PO confirmation
- Shipper delivery confirmation + invoice
- Meals receipts (label with attendee names/purpose when necessary)
- Conference registration receipt

Reimbursement timeline + action items:
- Submit expenses within 30 days of trip to Concur; delays may require manager approval.
- Attach receipts and fill expense codes.
- For vendor invoices > $2,500, route via AP process (invoice to ap@redwood.com, include PO#).

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm final GL codes with Finance (email finance@redwood.com) - assigned to Rachel - deadline 2026-03-10.
- [ ] Request itemized hotel invoice at check-in (remind front desk).
- [ ] Confirm swag shipping labels include booth number and contact phone at venue. Contact PrintHouse (Lisa).
- [ ] Confirm booth delivery window with FastShip and event logistics team.
- [ ] Submit pre-approval for any hospitality dinners >$500 (Jira ticket TRV-452 pending).
- [ ] Consolidate receipts into one expense report per trip; coordinate with Alex for shared receipts (rides).

Notes to self / helpful snippets:
- When submitting meals with multiple employees, include attendee names in the receipt attachment or note. Finance prefers a single PDF per receipt.
- If a receipt is lost, add a Missing Receipt form with explanation and approver note (manager signature required).
- Use corporate card for booth-related charges where possible to simplify reimbursement (confirm with Sam).
- Keep personal and company charges separate on the card - double-check folio before checkout.

Links / references:
- Confluence: KubeCon NA 2026 events page - https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Events/pages/4321 (draft event page)
- Jira travel approval: TRV-452 - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TRV-452 (pre-approval for hospitality)
- Slack thread: #events-kubecon - https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234ABCD (booth coordination thread)
